0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_000
0.description: Greetings and be welcome to the Sanctum. I am here to serve those couples who would be joined body and soul in the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: The Ceremony of Eternal Bonding is an optional service which allows two players to form an eternal bond with one another by completing the special quest “The Ties that Bind.” This quest is available to those who possess a promise wristlet, which may be acquired via the online store.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_010
2.description: Greetings and be welcome to the Sanctum. Is there aught I might assist you with as you prepare for your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding?

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q2_000_030
3.description: What would you like to do?

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_A2_000_031
4.description: Learn about the exchange of rings.

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_A2_000_032
5.description: Learn about making a ceremony plan.

6.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_A2_100_032
6.description: Learn how to schedule a ceremony.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_A2_000_035
9.description: Learn about the proceedings on ceremony day.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_A2_101_035
10.description: Ask what happens if I misplace my blank invitation.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_A2_102_035
11.description: Learn how to reschedule a ceremony.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_050
14.description: It is customary for the couple-to-be to exchange rings during the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding as a symbol of their undying devotion to one another.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_051
15.description: To this end, prior to the ceremony, each partner is asked to prepare a special ring─an eternity ring, 'tis called─to be presented to his or her soul mate.

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_052
16.description: Know, though, that this ring cannot be bought with coin alone. Nay, it must be tempered by love and blessed by the gods.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_053
17.description: Creating an eternity ring requires that you first obtain a flawless band to serve as the vessel. This item may be crafted or purchased.

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_054
18.description: Next, the band must be engraved with the marks of the Twelve at the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah. You and your partner must then embark on a pilgrimage to have your bands blessed by the gods.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_055
19.description: And that is an explanation of the rings in brief. If you wish to know more, Claribel yonder will be glad to provide you with guidance.

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_060
20.description: Having seen to your preparations for the rings, you and your partner may begin planning the ceremony itself.

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_061
21.description: Among other things, you will be asked to choose the type of ceremony you wish held, along with decorations for the venue.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_062
22.description: When the time comes for you to make these arrangements, Claribel will direct you to an attendant named Raitmeaux.

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_063
23.description: A word of warning: Raitmeaux will attend you and your partner separately. In order to ensure that your special day proceeds smoothly, it is best that the two of you agree upon a ceremony plan ahead of time.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_064
24.description: Once you have settled upon a plan, the next step is to schedule a date and time for the ceremony itself. Dedicant Etoinelle by the chapel entrance will assist you in this.

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_065
25.description: Further details can be had by asking the Sanctum acolyte about scheduling a ceremony.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_100_060
26.description: Once you and your partner have settled upon a ceremony plan, the next step is to schedule the ceremony itself. Dedicant Etoinelle by the chapel entrance will assist you in registering a date and time.

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_061
27.description: Towards the end of the quest “The Ties that Bind,” the option to schedule your ceremony will become available. To register a date and time, speak with Etoinelle while you are in a party with your partner, and both of you are equipped with your promise wristlets.

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_063
29.description: This means that a maximum of two weeks may pass between registration and the ceremony. In the intervening time, you may attend to other arrangements such as sending out invitations.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_064
30.description: Venue reservations are made for two-hour blocks (Earth time) on a first-come-first-served basis.

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_065
31.description: Please note that registration opens at different times depending on the service plan (platinum, gold, or standard) as denoted by your wristlet.

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_067
33.description: If you cancel your reservation, you must wait until the following <hex:020603130603><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> (Earth time) to reschedule.

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_068
34.description: In this case, however, please be warned that registration will open only from <hex:020603160603><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03>:00 <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> regardless of your service plan. This restriction will be lifted after two weeks have elapsed.

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_101_068
35.description: Please be advised that ceremonies cannot be held when Worlds are undergoing maintenance. To view the latest maintenance information, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>System<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the main menu, then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Support Desk<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

36.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_069
36.description: Lastly, registration may not be possible due to unforeseen circumstances. For details, please visit the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding site via the Lodestone.

37.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_070
37.description: Having prepared the rings and settled upon a ceremony plan, you and your partner must then attend to a number of matters.

38.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_071
38.description: At the time you schedule your ceremony, Dedicant Etoinelle will furnish you and your partner each with a blank invitation.

39.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_072
39.description: This document bears your ceremony's schedule, and serves as proof of your reservation. Please take care not to lose either copy, as you will be required to reschedule.

40.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_073
40.description: In addition, the document may also be used to create invitations to send to friends and acquaintances.

41.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_074
41.description: After inviting your guests, we recommend that you next decide upon your attire for the ceremony.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_075
42.description: As you go about this, perhaps the most important thing to keep in mind is the eternity ring, which may be concealed when certain gloves are worn. When in doubt, do a trial fitting.

43.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_076
43.description: Lastly, if you wish to alter your ceremony plans at this time, you may do so by consulting Raitmeaux within the Ivory Chapel. If you wish to review your partner's preferences, pray speak with Dedicant Etoinelle.

44.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_080
44.description: Having prepared the rings, settled upon a plan, and scheduled your ceremony, next comes the task of inviting guests.

45.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_081
45.description: Towards the end of the quest “The Ties that Bind,” after you have scheduled your ceremony, you and your partner will each receive a blank invitation from Etoinelle.

46.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_082
46.description: By using this item in your inventory, you can create invitations which may be given to friends in the same manner as an ordinary item.

47.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_083
47.description: The maximum number of guests is the same across all service plans. You and your partner may each send up to 40 invitations for a total of 80 guests.

48.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_083
48.description: When attending a ceremony, guests will be admitted to the venue by presenting their invitations to Etoinelle at the appointed time.

49.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_084
49.description: Please be warned that only those who possess an invitation may attend a ceremony. This requirement also extends to the hosts, who must be in possession of their blank invitations.

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_085
50.description: Commencement time and other details may be reviewed by examining the invitation in your inventory.

51.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_086
51.description: The ceremony proper commences 40 minutes (Earth time) after doors open, or earlier at the hosts' discretion.

52.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_087
52.description: Assuming that the ceremony is still in progress, guests may arrive at any time during your two-hour reservation.

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_088
53.description: In addition to showing people to the venue, Etoinelle will be on hand to provide assistance to guests.

54.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_090
54.description: Before you know it, the joyous day will be upon you. It would be prudent indeed to thoroughly acquaint yourself with the proceedings.

55.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_091
55.description: When the scheduled time arrives, both the couple to be joined and their guests may enter the venue by speaking with Etoinelle.

56.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_091
56.description: Please be warned that the ceremony will be postponed if both partners are not present at the venue within 20 minutes (Earth time) of doors opening.

57.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_092
57.description: The ceremony proper will commence no later than 40 minutes (Earth time) into the two-hour reservation.

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_093
58.description: Upon arriving at the venue, you and your partner will be shown to separate dressing rooms to attire yourself and finalize the ceremony plan.

59.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_094
59.description: Though the venue is reserved for two hours, the ceremony may conclude earlier.

60.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_095
60.description: On the day, you and your partner will each be entrusted with an eternity bell, which may be used to expedite the proceedings.

61.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_096
61.description: After you and your partner have finalized the ceremony plan in your respective dressing rooms, you will have another 20 minutes (Earth time) before the ceremony commences. If you do not wish to wait, however, you may begin immediately by ringing the eternity bell.

62.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_097
62.description: Your attire at the time of the ceremony's commencement will be reflected in the ceremony's opening cutscene. Please ensure that your appearance is as you desire beforehand.

63.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_098
63.description: The ceremony will proceed as follows:

64.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_099
64.description: Firstly, you and your partner will make your entrance and say your vows. This is followed by the blessing and exchange of rings. Last comes the reception, during which you may mingle with guests.

65.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_100
65.description: In the case that no guests were invited, the reception will be a private time between you and your partner.

66.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_101
66.description: Ordinarily, the ceremony will proceed through its stages at a predetermined pace. If both you and your partner ring the eternity bell, however, you may move to the next stage without waiting.

67.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_102
67.description: During the ceremony, you and your partner will receive eternity rings in exchange for your promise wristlets. On the day, please ensure that you have your blank invitation, your wristlet, and one free slot in your inventory.

68.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_103
68.description: Please be warned that the ceremony will be postponed if you are unable to receive your eternity ring, and you will be required to reschedule.

69.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_104
69.description: The ceremony will require a maximum of two hours (Earth time) from start to finish, after which you may report to Claribel to complete the special quest “The Ties that Bind” and receive the rewards.

70.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_120_100
70.description: If either you or your partner misplace your blank invitation, I am afraid that you will be unable to proceed with the ceremony.

71.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_120_101
71.description: In this case, you will be required to reschedule through Etoinelle.

72.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_120_102
72.description: Further details can be had by asking the Sanctum acolyte about rescheduling a ceremony.

73.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_130_100
73.description: If you are unable to proceed with a ceremony as planned, it is possible to reschedule.

74.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_130_101
74.description: To reschedule your ceremony, discard your blank invitation and then speak with Etoinelle.

75.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_130_102
75.description: You and your partner will each receive a new blank invitation with which you can create new invitations. At this time, it is recommended that you discard the old ones in order to avoid confusion.

76.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_130_103
76.description: Please note that you will be required to wait until the next <hex:020603160603><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> (Earth time) to register a new date and time. Furthermore, for the next two weeks, registration will only be available to you from <hex:020603160603><hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03>:00 <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> on the aforementioned day.

77.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_130_104
77.description: For details, please visit the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding site via the Lodestone.

78.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_130
78.description: Should circumstance necessitate the cancellation of your ceremony, I shall guide you through the procedure.

79.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_131
79.description: Please note that the following procedure is for those who wish to completely cancel their Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.

80.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_131
80.description: Canceling your ceremony requires that you hand over your promise wristlet to the Sanctum acolyte.

81.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_132
81.description: If you simply wish to postpone, you can learn about the procedure by asking the Sanctum acolyte about rescheduling a ceremony.

82.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q3_000_140
82.description: Do you wish to cancel your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding?

85.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_142
85.description: You may cancel your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding by handing over your promise wristlet to the Sanctum acolyte. The special quest “The Ties that Bind” will be abandoned at this time.

86.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_101_142
86.description: Should you later wish to hold a ceremony, you must acquire a new promise wristlet via the online store.

87.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_101_143
87.description: You will now be asked to confirm the cancellation of your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding.

88.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q3_100_143
88.description: Do you wish to cancel your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding?

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q3_200_146
91.description: Are you certain you wish to cancel your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding?

94.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_165
94.description: It is done─your ceremony has been canceled. If there is aught else I might assist you with, do not hesitate to ask.

95.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_170
95.description: Could not cancel the ceremony. An error has occurred.

96.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_175
96.description: Could not cancel the ceremony. You do not possess any promise wristlets.

97.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_100_200
97.description: Ah, a familiar face. 'Tis always a delight when those who were joined here return for a visit. Now then, is there something I might assist you with?

98.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q4_000_201
98.description: What would you like to do?

103.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_180
103.description: ...Another ceremony, you say? I take it you wish to form an eternal bond with a new partner. Very well, I shall explain to you the process that you must undertake.

104.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_181
104.description: It has been decreed that an individual may have no more than one eternal bond at any given time.

105.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_182
105.description: As such, before you do aught else, you must needs annul your existing bond by relinquishing your eternity ring to the Sanctum.

106.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_182
106.description: You may relinquish your eternity ring by speaking with the Sanctum acolyte and selecting “Annul an existing eternal bond” when prompted.

107.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_200
107.description: Though it is most regrettable, some bonds were not meant to be.

108.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_100_202
108.description: If circumstance compels you to annul your eternal bond, you may do so by relinquishing your eternity ring to me.

109.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_203
109.description: At least ten days must have elapsed from the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding before you can relinquish your eternity ring.

110.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q5_000_202
110.description: Do you wish to relinquish your eternity ring?

113.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q8_100_205
113.description: Are you certain you wish to relinquish your eternity ring?

116.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_210
116.description: It is done─your eternal bond has been annulled. May you find true happiness in the future.

117.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_220
117.description: You have but recently held a ceremony, have you not? My apologies, but you must wait longer before you may annul your eternal bond. Pray return here if your mind is unchanged after the requisite time has passed.

118.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_221
118.description: At least ten days must have elapsed from the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding before you can relinquish your eternity ring.

119.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_222
119.description: Could not annul eternal bond. Your eternity ring is not in your inventory.

120.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_240
120.description: I shall take off your hands those promise wristlets that you no longer require.

121.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_100_240
121.description: If you possess excess promise wristlets or have no further use for them, you may discard them through the Sanctum acolyte.

122.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_241
122.description: What is it that you wish discarded?

123.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_242
123.description: Hm? It would seem that you do not possess any promise wristlets.

124.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q6_000_250
124.description: Select the wristlet you wish to discard.

126.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q9_000_260
126.description: Are you certain you wish to discard this wristlet?

129.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_270
129.description: Very well, I shall add this to the pile bound for the smelter.

130.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_SYSTEM_000_271
130.description: Could not discard the promise wristlet. An error has occurred.

132.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_DEACON00214_000_950
132.description: Are you experiencing any difficulties pertaining to the Ceremony of Eternal Bonding? If so, please do not hesitate to tell me. I should be glad to assist in any way I am able.

133.name: TEXT_CMNDEFWEDDINGRECOVERY_00214_Q10_000_950
133.description: What would you like to do?
